evidence.decision: After the temporary Jurchen seed transfers provenance and is retired, and the preserved original Nurhaci Activity is relinked to the distinct Jurchen Later Jin identity, preserve polity UUID 0c1849ca-e4ae-572b-bfe3-0253aa08d83a for the Five-Dynasties Later Jin (後晉) and disambiguate its preferred English/Korean display names.
evidence.identity_rule: Five-Dynasties Later Jin (後晉, 936–947) and Jurchen Later Jin/후금 (後金, 1616–1636) are distinct polity identities despite the shared English rendering 'Later Jin'.
